resources.string: Shows your logins under sign-in fields in apps like Discord

Some apps (Discord, and others built with React Native) hide the Android autofill list as soon as the keyboard opens. With this on, Vault shows its own list under the sign-in field instead: your logins for that app, and 2FA codes in a code field, after your fingerprint or screen lock. Vault only looks at the sign-in fields of the app in front, and nothing leaves your phone.
